mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_dispatch_job ( id, event_id, incident_id, event_type, payload_format_version, payload, source_entity_type, source_entity_id, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{id, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{eventId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{incidentId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{eventType}, #{payloadFormatVersion}, #{payloadJson}::jsonb, #{sourceEntityType}, #{sourceEntityId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{occurredAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM event_dispatch_job WHERE id = #{id, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} FOR UPDATE

WITH incident_heads AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (job.incident_id) job.id FROM event_dispatch_job job WHERE job.dispatch_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED', 'DISPATCHING') AND ORDER BY job.incident_id, job.sse_sequence NULLS LAST, job.created_at, job.insertion_order NULLS FIRST, job.id ), claimed AS ( SELECT job.id FROM event_dispatch_job job JOIN incident_heads head ON head.id = job.id WHERE job.dispatch_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY job.created_at, job.insertion_order NULLS FIRST, job.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF job SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE event_dispatch_job job SET dispatch_status = #{claimStatus} FROM claimed WHERE job.id = claimed.id RETURNING job.id, job.event_id, job.incident_id, job.event_type, job.payload_format_version, job.payload::text AS payload_json, job.source_entity_type, job.source_entity_id, job.occurred_at, job.dispatch_status, job.sse_sequence
